integrity: A symbolic proof and a standard-library exhaustive checker are provided. Finite checks cover n=2..9; no independent proof audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only centralizers of nonzero powers of the canonical full shift, not arbitrary elements. Stable-range formula requires n>=2k-1; all-size polynomial remains valid. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Rank-refined centralizers of canonical shifts in order-decreasing partial-isometry monoids
